```{r Función percentil pesado}

percentil_cima <- function(var, weights, percentil = "quintil", normwt = TRUE) {
  
  n_grupos <- c(tercil = 3, cuartil = 4, quintil = 5, decil = 10)
  
  if (!percentil %in% names(n_grupos)) {
    stop("`percentil` debe ser: ", paste(names(n_grupos), collapse = ", "))
  }
  
  k <- n_grupos[[percentil]]
  probs <- seq_len(k-1)/k
  etiquetas <- paste0("Grupo Q", seq_len(k))
  
  # factor vacío con los niveles correctos, para los casos degenerados
  vacio <- factor(rep(NA_character_, length(var)),
                  levels = etiquetas, ordered = TRUE)
  
  # casos utilizables: sin NA en var ni en el peso, y peso positivo
  ok <- !is.na(var) & !is.na(weights) & weights > 0
  
  # sin datos suficientes o sin variabilidad -> NA en vez de error
  if (sum(ok) < k || dplyr::n_distinct(var[ok]) < k) {
    warning("Grupo sin datos suficientes para ", k, " grupos; se devuelve NA.",
            call. = FALSE)
    return(vacio)
  }
  
  cortes <- Hmisc::wtd.quantile(
    var[ok], 
    weights = weights[ok], 
    probs = probs,
    na.rm = TRUE, 
    type = '(i-1)/(n-1)', 
    normwt = normwt
  )
  
  # cortes empatados -> breaks no estrictamente crecientes -> cut() falla
  if (any(duplicated(cortes))) {
    warning("Cortes empatados en ", percentil, "; se devuelve NA.", call. = FALSE)
    return(vacio)
  }
  
  cut(
    var,
    breaks = c(-Inf, cortes, Inf),
    labels = etiquetas,
    right = TRUE,                               
    ordered_result = TRUE
  )
  
}
```

```{r Funciones para depuración}

fun_acceso <- function(x) {
  x <- as.numeric(as.character(x))
  case_when(
    x == 0 ~ "Sin acceso",
    x >  0 ~ "Con acceso",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

fun_ratio <- function(num, den) {
  
  num <- as.numeric(as.character(num)); den <- as.numeric(as.character(den))
  
  case_when(
    is.na(num) | is.na(den) ~ NA_real_,
    den <= 0 ~ NA_real_,   # denominador inválido
    TRUE ~ num / den
  )
}

fun_financia <- function(gob, p2, p3, p4) {
  
  num <- function(z) as.numeric(as.character(z))
  gob <- num(gob); p2 <- num(p2); p3 <- num(p3); p4 <- num(p4)
  tot <- gob + p2 + p3 + p4
  
  tibble(
    tot_fin  = tot,
    financia = case_when(
      gob == tot & tot != 0 ~ "Public",
      gob == 0   & tot != 0 ~ "Private",
      gob != 0 & gob != tot & tot != 0 ~ "Mixed",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
}

fun_area <- function(x, etiquetas_rural) {
  
  x <- str_trim(as.character(x))
  
  case_when(
    is.na(x) ~ NA_character_, x %in% etiquetas_rural ~ "Rural", 
    TRUE ~ "Urban"
  )
}

fun_lengua <- function(x, etiquetas_test) {
  
  x <- str_trim(as.character(x))
  
  case_when(
    is.na(x) ~ NA_character_, x %in% etiquetas_test ~ "Language of test",
    TRUE ~ "Another language"
  )
}

fun_gestion <- function(x, publico, privado) {
  
  x <- str_trim(as.character(x))
  
  case_when(
    x %in% publico ~ "Public", 
    x %in% privado ~ "Private", 
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

fun_dispositivo <- function(x) {
  
  x <- str_trim(as.character(x))
  
  case_when(
    x %in% "I do not have this subject" ~ NA_character_,
    x %in% c(
      "In about half of the lessons",
      "In more than half of the lessons",
      "In every or almost every lesson") ~ "Yes",
    x %in% c(
      "Never or almost never",
      "In less than half of the lessons") ~ "No",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

fun_quintil_escs <- function(df, escs = "ESCS", grupo = "CNT") {
  
  df %>%
    mutate(
      across(all_of(escs), 
             ~as.numeric(as.character(.x)))
    ) %>%  
    group_by(across(all_of(grupo))) %>%
    mutate(
      quintil_escs = percentil_cima(.data[[escs]], W_FSTUWT, "quintil")
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
}

fun_horas <- function(x) {
  
  x <- str_trim(as.character(x))
  
  case_when(
    x == "None"                                ~ 0,
    x == "Up to 1 hour"                        ~ 0.5,
    x == "More than 1 hour and up to 2 hours"  ~ 1.5,
    x == "More than 2 hours and up to 3 hours" ~ 2.5,
    x == "More than 3 hours and up to 4 hours" ~ 3.5,
    x == "More than 4 hours and up to 5 hours" ~ 4.5,
    x == "More than 5 hours and up to 6 hours" ~ 5.5,
    x == "More than 6 hours and up to 7 hours" ~ 6.5,
    x == "More than 7 hours"                   ~ 7.5,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )
}

```

```{r Depuración específica}

bases_dep <- list(pisa00, pisa03, pisa06, pisa09, pisa12, pisa15, pisa17, pisa18, pisa22) %>% 
  set_names(c(2000, 2003, 2006, 2009, 2012, 2015, 2017, 2018, 2022)) %>% 
  modify_at(
    "2000", 
    ~.x %>%
      mutate(
        lengua = fun_lengua(ST17Q01, "<Test language>"),
        area = fun_area(SC01Q01, "Village (less 3 000)")
      ) %>% 
      mutate(fun_financia(SC04Q01,SC04Q02,SC04Q03,SC04Q04)) %>%  # Tipo de financiamiento de la escuela ("pública, privada, mixta)
      rename(
        gestion = SC03Q01, sex = ST03Q01
      )
  ) %>% 
  modify_at(
    "2003", 
    ~.x %>%
      mutate(
        lengua = fun_lengua(ST16Q01, "<Test language>"),
        area = fun_area(SC01Q01, "Village (less 3 000)")
      ) %>%
      fun_quintil_escs(escs="ESCS", grupo="COUNTRY") %>%   # no comparable
      mutate(fun_financia(SC04Q01,SC04Q02,SC04Q03,SC04Q04)) %>% # Tipo de financiamiento de la escuela ("pública, privada, mixta)
      rename(sex = ST03Q01, gestion = SC03Q01)
  ) %>% 
  modify_at(
    "2006", 
    ~.x %>%
      mutate(
        fun_financia(SC03Q01, SC03Q02, SC03Q03, SC03Q04),
        area = fun_area(SC07Q01, "Village"),
        lengua = fun_lengua(ST12Q01, "Language of test")
      ) %>%
      fun_quintil_escs(escs="ESCS", grupo="COUNTRY") %>%   # no comparable
      rename(sex = ST04Q01, gestion = SC02Q01)
  ) %>% 
  modify_at(
    "2009", 
    ~.x %>%
      mutate(
        acceso_pc = fun_acceso(SC10Q02), # Acceso a pc
        acceso_internet = fun_acceso(SC10Q03), # Acceso a internet 
        comp_est = fun_ratio(SC10Q02, SC10Q01), # Ratio computadora x estudiantes
        area = fun_area(SC04Q01, "Village"), # área geográfica
        lengua = fun_lengua(ST19Q01, "Language of test")  # Lengua de la prueba
      ) %>%
      fun_quintil_escs(escs = "ESCS", grupo = "CNT") %>%  # Quintiles socioeconómicos
      mutate(fun_financia(SC03Q01, SC03Q02, SC03Q03, SC03Q04)) %>%  # Tipo de financiamiento de la escuela ("pública, privada, mixta)
      rename(sex = ST04Q01, gestion = SC02Q01)
  ) %>% 
  modify_at(
    "2012", 
    ~.x %>%
      mutate(
        nervios_mat_prob = case_when(
          is.na(ST42Q05) ~ NA_character_,
          ST42Q05 %in% c("Strongly agree", "Agree") ~ "Math nervious",
          TRUE ~ "Not math nervious"
        ),
        acceso_internet = fun_acceso(SC11Q03),
        acceso_pc = fun_acceso(SC11Q02),
        comp_est = fun_ratio(SC11Q02, SC11Q01)
      ) %>%
      mutate(across(c(SCHOOLID, STIDSTD), as.numeric)) %>%
      left_join(iso_paises, by = c("CNT" = "nom_pais")) %>%
      left_join(escs_12,   by = c("isoalpha3", "SCHOOLID", "STIDSTD")) %>%
      mutate(
        area = fun_area(SC03Q01, "Village"),
        lengua = fun_lengua(ST25Q01, "Language of the test")
      ) %>%
      mutate(fun_financia(SC02Q01, SC02Q02, SC02Q03, SC02Q04)) %>% 
      fun_quintil_escs(escs = "ESCS_TREND", grupo = "CNT")   %>%      # comparable 2012 en adelante
      rename(sex = ST04Q01, gestion = SC01Q01)
  ) %>% 
  modify_at(
    "2015", 
    ~.x %>%
      mutate(
        acceso_internet = fun_acceso(SC004Q03TA),
        acceso_pc = fun_acceso(SC004Q02TA),
        comp_est = fun_ratio(SC004Q02TA, SC004Q01TA),
        SCHOOLID = as.numeric(str_sub(CNTSCHID, -5, -1)),
        STIDSTD = as.numeric(str_sub(CNTSTUID, -5, -1)),
        area = fun_area(SC001Q01TA,
                        "A village, hamlet or rural area (fewer than 3 000 people)"),
        lengua  = fun_lengua(ST022Q01TA, "Language of test"),
        gestion = fun_gestion(SC013Q01TA,
                              publico = "A public school",
                              privado = "A private school")
      ) %>%
      left_join(iso_paises, by = c("CNT" = "nom_pais")) %>%
      left_join(escs_15, by = c("isoalpha3", "SCHOOLID", "STIDSTD")) %>%
      mutate(fun_financia(SC016Q01TA, SC016Q02TA, SC016Q03TA, SC016Q04TA)) %>% 
      fun_quintil_escs(escs = "ESCS_TREND", grupo = "CNT")   %>%     # comparable 2012 en adelante
      rename(sex = ST004D01T)
  ) %>% 
  modify_at(
    "2017",
    ~.x %>% 
      mutate(
        area = fun_area(SC001Q01TA,
                        "A village, hamlet or rural area (fewer than 3 000 people)"),
        lengua  = fun_lengua(ST021Q01TA, "Language of test"),
        gestion = fun_gestion(SC006Q01TA,
                              publico = "A public school",
                              privado = "A private school")
      ) %>% 
      mutate(fun_financia(SC008Q01TA,SC008Q02TA,SC008Q03TA,SC008Q04TA)) %>% 
      fun_quintil_escs(escs = "ESCS15", grupo = "CNT") %>%      # No comparable en tendencia
      rename(sex = ST004D01T)
  ) %>% 
  modify_at(
    "2018", 
    ~.x %>%
      mutate(
        nervios_lang_test= case_when(
          is.na(WB168Q03HA) ~ NA_character_,
          WB168Q03HA %in% c("Quite a bit", "Extremely") ~ "Lang test nervious",
          TRUE ~ "Not lang test nervious"
        ),
        acceso_internet = fun_acceso(SC004Q03TA),
        acceso_pc = fun_acceso(SC004Q02TA),
        comp_est = fun_ratio(SC004Q02TA, SC004Q01TA),
        SCHOOLID = as.numeric(str_sub(CNTSCHID, -5, -1)),
        STIDSTD = as.numeric(str_sub(CNTSTUID, -5, -1)),
        gestion = fun_gestion(SC013Q01TA,
                              publico = "A public school (Managed by a public education authority, government agency, or governing board)",
                              privado = "A private school (Managed by a non-government org; e.g. a church, trade union, business, or other private institution.)"),
        area = fun_area(SC001Q01TA,
                        "A village, hamlet or rural area (fewer than 3 000 people)"),
        lengua  = fun_lengua(ST022Q01TA, "Language of the test")
      ) %>%
      left_join(iso_paises, by = c("CNT" = "nom_pais")) %>%
      left_join(escs_18,   by = c("isoalpha3", "SCHOOLID", "STIDSTD")) %>%
      mutate(fun_financia(SC016Q01TA, SC016Q02TA, SC016Q03TA, SC016Q04TA)) %>% 
      fun_quintil_escs(escs = "ESCS_TREND", grupo = "CNT") %>% 
      rename(sex = ST004D01T) 
  ) %>% 
  modify_at(
    "2022", 
    ~.x %>%
      mutate(
        nervios_mat_prob = case_when(
          is.na(ST292Q03JA) ~ NA_character_,
          ST292Q03JA %in% c("Strongly agree", "Agree") ~ "Math nervious",
          TRUE ~ "Not math nervious"
        ),
        nervios_lang_test= case_when(
          is.na(WB168Q03HA) ~ NA_character_,
          WB168Q03HA %in% c("Quite a bit", "Extremely") ~ "Lang test nervious",
          TRUE ~ "Not lang test nervious"
        ),
        acceso_internet = fun_acceso(SC004Q03TA),
        acceso_pc = fun_acceso(SC004Q02TA),
        comp_est = fun_ratio(SC004Q02TA, SC004Q01TA),
        tablet_est = fun_ratio(SC004Q08JA, SC004Q01TA),
        gestion = fun_gestion(SC013Q01TA,
                              publico = "A public school(This is a school managed directly or indirectly by a public education authority, government agency, or g",
                              privado = "A private school(This is a school managed directly or indirectly by a non-government organisation; e.g. a church, trade"),
        area = fun_area(SC001Q01TA,
                        "A village, hamlet or rural area (fewer than 3 000 people)"),
        lengua = fun_lengua(ST022Q01TA, "Language of the test")
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        dig_dev_learning = fun_horas(ST326Q01JA),
        dig_dev_leisure  = fun_horas(ST326Q04JA)
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        dig_dev_total = case_when(
          if_all(c(dig_dev_learning, dig_dev_leisure), is.na) ~ NA_real_,
          TRUE ~ rowSums(across(c(dig_dev_learning, dig_dev_leisure)), na.rm = TRUE)
        )
      )%>% 
      mutate(
        dig_dev_lang = fun_dispositivo(IC173Q01JA),
        dig_dev_math = fun_dispositivo(IC173Q02JA),
        dig_dev_scie = fun_dispositivo(IC173Q03JA),
        dig_dev_it   = fun_dispositivo(IC173Q04JA)
      ) %>%
      mutate(fun_financia(SC016Q01TA, SC016Q02TA, SC016Q03TA, SC016Q04TA)) %>% 
      fun_quintil_escs(escs = "ESCS", grupo = "CNT") %>% 
      rename(sex = ST004D01T)
  )
```
